title: Site behind Cloudflare loops with ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS after the origin forces HTTPS
symptoms: curl -I shows 301 to the same https URL repeatedly
Starts right after enabling Force HTTPS in WordPress, Laravel, or nginx
cause: In Flexible mode Cloudflare talks to the origin over plain HTTP, so an origin that redirects HTTP to HTTPS answers every proxied request with a redirect. The browser keeps following it forever.
fix: Install a certificate on the origin and switch the zone to Full (strict), or drop the origin redirect and use Always Use HTTPS at Cloudflare.
apply: Cloudflare dashboard > your zone > SSL/TLS > Overview > Encryption mode: Full (strict)
affected: Cloudflare zones using Flexible SSL/TLS with an origin that redirects to HTTPS
